THE ECHO BELOW · SCENE
Area 6 · South barracks
Change prepared scene
Say aloud

Rows of stone bunks flank an old brazier. Three gaunt shapes crouch over the scattered bones, working their jaws against scraps far too old to feed them.

The bunks and old brazier break the chamber into narrower gaps than its size first suggests. The shapes among the bones are occupied with what lies before them. You can stop at the entrance to judge those gaps, choose where to stand, or decide whether to make your presence known.

Ask the players

Do you listen first, slip past, draw them out, or enter?
